caption: A stripe of translucent blue watercolour is painted over a dry yellow stripe, and the overlap looks green.

sa.check: A yellow stripe is on paper.
A stripe of blue watercolour is painted over it.
The yellow stripe is dry and the blue is translucent.

pc.expect: Only the overlapping band is green, and the yellow and blue outside it keep their colours.
pc.fail: The overlap is a colour other than green; or the pure stripes change; or the whole sheet turns green.

pc.expect: The green appears as the blue is painted over the yellow and only there.
pc.fail: Green appears before the brush arrives; or where the stripes do not cross; or the brush passes and no green appears.

pc.expect: The watercolour is translucent and lies as a wash on the dry paper.
pc.fail: It is opaque and hides the yellow; or it beads off; or the paper dissolves.

pc.expect: Paint goes only where the brush puts it.
pc.fail: It spreads by itself on dry paper; or the brush moves by itself; or the paper moves.
The sheet duplicates; or the brush vanishes; or paint appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: The paper and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes shape; or the table changes; or the brush changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
